_doc: Goal library (spec 2026-11-03 §5): kind + where (the filter of targets; $param from the call) + make (the state to reach; $same = keep the object's value) + required params (asked when missing, never defaulted). Raw goals have the same shape. light: "day" = the goal reads bubble kinds (unreliable at dusk/night, D185): outside daylight it stops and suggests sleeping. fresh: "day" = an object failing the filter only by a reading from an earlier game day is visited and looked at (crops ripen overnight; the click result stamps it fresh, user D188).
